_comment: Wave G G4a — AT-G23 goldens for the four hard layout fixtures.
These pin PAGE COUNT and TEXT-OP EXTENTS, deliberately NOT raw bytes: a jspdf
patch bump would invalidate byte goldens all at once and present as four
unexplained failures, while structural facts stay meaningful across patch
releases and still catch the layout regressions the fixtures exist for.
topMm/bottomMm are text baselines in mm from the page top; the reserved
footer band is excluded (see PDF_FOOTER_BAND_MM in pdfRenderHarness.ts).
bottomMarginMm is the generator's own margin — no text may fall below it.
